items.detail: Questions written, ordered, categorized, and attached to the assessment.
OME previews on an iPad, flags issues, prints backup copies, and builds the proctor deck.
Students can now download the exam onto their iPads.
Examplify locks the iPad for the duration.
The assessment overview updates as answer files come in.

blocks.title: Fix content before the download window opens
blocks.text: Once a student has downloaded the assessment, questions and answer keys lock. Errors after that point become scoring adjustments.
